contract: Walk physical ADTS extents with inspect_adts_header and parse each with AacAdtsParser. The reference opens a raw AAC demuxer without stream discovery, reads each packet and filters it with aac_adtstoasc.

Fold kind 2 with the length and exact bytes of the candidate ASC header projection and reference ASC, initially or when the filter reports an update. Fold kind 1 with source offset, input frame length, object type, sampling index, channel configuration, protection-absent flag, payload length and exact payload bytes. The reference projects the configuration fields from the active ASC and the protection flag from the demuxed header.
Fold kind 7 with the frame count on clean end or kind 8 with the source offset on refusal or leftover input. Operate on preloaded bytes and include parser, demuxer and filter setup and teardown.
